description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractListener' implementing the 'EventSubscriberInterface'. It provides common functionality for event listeners, such as accessing the service container and services, and uses a LoggerTrait for logging capabilities.

classes.name: AbstractListener
classes.description: An abstract base class for event listeners that provides methods to access services and a logger.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that optionally accepts a LoggerInterface instance and sets it.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Returns a specific service from the application's service container.
